question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Make waves
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"Make waves"** means to cause difficulty or disturbance by attracting a lot of attention or causing problems. (परेशानी पैदा करना)

 
 
• **Example: **His radical ideas **made waves **in the conservative community.
 
 
 
• **"To cause difficulty"** means to create trouble or complications for someone or something. (कठिनाई पैदा करना)
 
 
• **Example: **Her constant complaints are** causing difficulties** for the management.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **To give up **(हार मान लेना): To stop trying to do something because it is too difficult.

 
 
• **Example:** He decided **to give up** smoking for his health.
 
 
 
• **To take it easy **(आराम करना): To relax and not worry about anything.
 
 
• **Example: **After the exams, she decided** to take it easy **for a few days.
 
 
 
• **To have patience** (धैर्य रखना): To wait calmly for something without getting angry or upset.
 
 
• **Example:** You need **to have patience** when dealing with young children.
